newsitem.title: USA: Glenayre holder files derivative lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Glenayre holder files derivative lawsuit.

text.p: Glenayre Technologies Inc confirmed Wednesday that a shareholder's derivative lawsuit has been filed by a shareholder against certain current and former members of its board of directors.
Glenayre said the lawsuit was filed on February 20 in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York.
Shareholders had filed a class action in November 1996 against the company, alleging that some executives concealed facts about Glenayre's financial condition.
The company said the lawsuit alleges that certain current and former board members breached their duties to Glenayre. No other details were provided.
Glenayre president Gary Smith said, "As I stated last November, we believe that the allegations of the so-called shareholders' lawsuit are totally without merit."
"The new lawsuit is basically a repackaging of the same allegations and we believe that it is also meritless. Both suits will be defended vigorously."
